user.title: Anker account
user.description: Log in with the Anker account that OWNS the charger (shared/member accounts cannot use MQTT).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The Anker login for {email} stopped working. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anker cloud.
error.no_devices: No supported charger found in this account. Supported so far: Anker Prime Charger 250W (A2345).

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant asks the charger for a full status update over MQTT.
data_description.fast_updates_minutes: Fast updates (port values every second) stop by themselves after this long.

save_custom_profile.name: Save custom profile
save_custom_profile.description: Change a custom charging profile saved in the Anker cloud (the app's custom modes): its name, port powers, protocols and automatic deactivation. Unset fields keep their value. Doesn't apply it to the charger; select it in Charging mode for that.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Name of the saved custom profile to change.

from_charger.name: Start from the charger's settings
from_charger.description: Start from the charger's current custom settings (the custom power limit, protocol and automatic deactivation entities) instead of the profile's own; the fields below change them further.

auto_deactivation.name: Automatic deactivation
auto_deactivation.description: Leave the custom mode when a port set to 0 W is used for charging.

a_power.name: USB-A power
a_power.description: Both USB-A ports together: 0, 15 or 24 W.

c1_protocols.name: USB-C 1 protocols
c1_protocols.description: Fast-charging protocols allowed on the port; which ones depends on its power (15-20 W: ufcs; 21-22 W: + pps11v, pd12v; 23-44 W: + scp; 45 W and more: + pps16v, pps20v, xiaomi).

c2_protocols.name: USB-C 2 protocols
c2_protocols.description: Fast-charging protocols allowed on the port; which ones depends on its power (15-20 W: ufcs; 21-22 W: + pps11v, pd12v; 23-44 W: + scp; 45 W and more: + pps16v, pps20v, xiaomi).

c3_protocols.name: USB-C 3 protocols

create_custom_profile.name: Create custom profile
create_custom_profile.description: Create a custom charging profile in the Anker cloud (at most 4), from the charger's current custom settings (the custom power limit, protocol and automatic deactivation entities); the fields change them. Doesn't apply it; select it in Charging mode for that.
